rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize test limits and thresholds
Detect PT-2001 wire break alarm condition
Detect overpressure alarm condition
Detect supply air low alarm condition while busy
Reset faults via PB-0002 fault reset pushbutton
Aggregate alarms and E-stop status to fault active flag and beacon
Manual vent control via PB-2010 in manual mode
Start automatic test sequence when pallet is in position
Advance from CLAMP to FILL when clamp is closed
Fill sequence timeout timer
Trigger fill timeout alarm if fill timer completes
Advance from FILL to STABILISE when fill complete threshold is reached
Stabilisation duration timer
Capture initial test pressure when test window starts
Advance from STABILISE to TEST when stabilisation timer completes
Test window duration timer
Capture final test pressure and calculate pressure decay
Evaluate pressure decay against limits for PASS or FAIL result
Advance from TEST to VENT when test window timer completes
Abort sequence to VENT and FAIL on fault condition
Vent duration timer
Advance from VENT to UNCLAMP when depressurised and timer completes
Advance from UNCLAMP to COMPLETE when clamp opens
Clear ST20 busy and COMPLETE when pallet leaves station
Drive XY-2002 clamp close solenoid during active sequential steps
Drive XV-2003 fill valve during FILL step
Drive XV-2004 vent valve during VENT step or overpressure condition
Output PASS or FAIL signals to line controller when step COMPLETE is active
End of ST20 routine
